rationale: Russian mass-casualty strike on Ukrainian buses (30 killed) is a significant escalation in the Black Sea region, raising security concerns for Romania's northern neighbor and potential refugee flows. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
top_events.label: Russia strikes buses in Kramatorsk killing 30
top_events.summary: Russia targeted two crowded buses in Kramatorsk, killing at least 30 civilians in a deliberate mass-casualty attack. The escalation affects Romania's northern neighbor and regional security.

top_events.title: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
top_events.label: Winter strikes force Kyiv residents to flee
top_events.summary: Renewed Russian strikes on energy infrastructure are forcing some Kyiv residents to leave the capital as winter approaches, potentially increasing refugee flows to Romania.

top_events.title: Ethiopia launches drone attack against Eritrean troops who crossed into Tigray
top_events.label: Ethiopia drone strikes Eritrean troops in Tigray
top_events.summary: Ethiopian forces attacked Eritrean troops in Tigray, raising the risk of a regional war in the Horn of Africa. Distant conflict with no direct impact on Romania.

most_significant_event.label: Russian missile kills 19 in Ukraine apartment
